improvements: Rebuilt the source base, 75–114 m tower, mapped 27 m pyramidal copper roof, lantern and 148 m tip.
Removed invented dormers and replaced broad collision strips with exact source polygons.
Pioneer Square and shared tourist skyline Smith silhouettes now reuse this registry model.
remainingGaps: Terracotta ornament, facade bay alterations and lantern detail remain procedural.
The tiny mapped upper part is simplified into the tip profile; no interior or surveyed roof access is represented.
These are isolated front/top/oblique model studies, not matched street-eye Street View/aerial comparisons. They do not establish full-world, night, weather or seasonal parity.
Integrated source-only replacement and rebuilt district performance are separate acceptance checks; the capture branch predates that shared world policy.
